summary.text: Naseem Khan took 5 for 42 as NPLU19 scored 152-10, with Sohail Kunwar top-scoring with 33 off 71 balls. Ayaan Misbah scored 75 off 104 balls to help UAEU19 reach 158-3 after Bipin Sharma took 1 for 24, resulting in a 7 wickets win for United Arab Emirates U19.
